name: Transwest Capital
summary: Freight factoring with a near-full advance, month-to-month or longer contracts, and a TCS fuel card.
differentiator: Lets you choose month-to-month or a longer contract, and states no setup, monthly minimum or invoice fees. Its fuel card is a TCS partnership card.

terms.advance: Typically a full advance less a small factoring fee, same day
terms.otherFees: No setup fees or invoice fees
